hotels.title: Tropical Beachfront Coffs Harbour Escape with Three Pools, Tennis Courts & Day Spa
hotels.description: Immerse yourself in uninterrupted coastal bliss at this relaxed, tropical-style resort, conveniently positioned on the stunning shores of Diggers Beach, Coffs Harbour. Savour the perfect blend of seaside fun and relaxation with three pools, three tennis courts and a tranquil day spa for all your pampering needs. Unwind in the elegantly appointed rooms and villas, and indulge in local cuisine at the two onsite restaurants, overlooking the beach. You'll never be lost for activities with everything from mini golf to beach volleyball. Beyond the resort, there is also the Coffs Harbour Marina and the renowned The Big Banana Fun Park nearby - ideal for some family-friendly fun!

hotels.title: Central Coffs Harbour Escape near Botanic Gardens with Outdoor Swimming Pool
hotels.description: Discover Coffs Harbour from a convenient base at this urban retreat, located just moments from the city centre. This relaxed hotel offers the essentials for a comfortable stay, with cosy rooms designed for fuss-free relaxation. Enjoy easy access to local dining options and major transport routes for seamless travel through the region. If you're staying a while, you'll find some of Coffs Harbour’s best attractions within easy reach. Visit the iconic Big Banana Fun Park, wander along Jetty Beach or explore scenic walking tracks in the surrounding national parks. With coastal viewpoints, cafes and family-friendly activities close by, this is an ideal base for discovering the best of New South Wales' North Coast.
